title: Enter the studio from the landing page
description: A first-time visitor can open the landing page and launch the studio workspace successfully.

steps.description: Click the control to launch the studio workspace
Verify the studio editor is displayed
Verify the canvas workspace is available

title: Launch the studio from the landing page
description: This verifies a first-time visitor can open the public landing page and enter the studio workspace from the main call to action.

steps.description: Click the link to launch the studio
Verify the studio workspace is displayed

title: Draw with the pencil tool on the canvas
description: A creator can select a drawing tool and make visible pixel changes on the canvas.

steps.description: Verify artwork is visible on the canvas

title: Draw and erase on the canvas
description: This verifies a user can create pixel art on the canvas with drawing tools and remove marks with the eraser.

steps.description: Verify the canvas reflects both the drawing and erasing actions

title: Export artwork as PNG
description: This verifies a user can open the export dialog, choose PNG, select a scale, and download a still image export.

steps.description: Verify a PNG export is available to download

title: Export animation as GIF
description: This verifies an animator can export the current project as a GIF with the chosen scale.

steps.description: Verify a GIF export is available to download

title: Review the landing page before starting
description: A visitor can view the landing page overview and then enter the studio to begin working.

steps.description: Scroll to review the featured capabilities
Click the control to launch the studio workspace
Verify the studio editor is displayed

title: Use fill and eyedropper to recolor artwork
description: This verifies a creator can sample an existing color and recolor areas of the artwork using the fill and eyedropper tools.

steps.description: Draw at least two differently colored regions on the canvas
Sample one of the drawn colors
Fill a bounded area on the canvas
Verify the artwork uses the sampled color and the filled region changes as expected

title: Erase part of a drawing
description: A creator can remove pixels from existing artwork using the eraser tool.

steps.description: Verify the canvas updates to reflect the erased area

title: Add and edit content on a new layer
description: This verifies a user can create a new layer and continue drawing so the composition is built across layers.

steps.description: Verify the layer stack includes the new layer and the artwork remains visible

title: Use fill or recolor to change an area
description: A creator can flood fill or recolor a region and see the selected area update to the chosen color.

steps.description: Draw a closed shape on the canvas
Click inside the enclosed area on the canvas
Verify the filled area is displayed on the canvas

title: Create and duplicate animation frames
description: This verifies an animator can add a frame, duplicate it, and edit the copy while keeping both frames in the timeline.

steps.description: Verify the timeline shows both frames and the duplicate can be distinguished by its edited content

title: Play and pause the animation
description: This verifies a user can preview sprite motion by starting playback and then pausing it.

steps.description: Create at least two frames with different drawings
Verify frame playback can be started and stopped

title: Mirror a drawing across the canvas
description: A creator can enable symmetry mode and see drawing mirrored on the opposite side of the canvas.

steps.description: Draw on one side of the canvas
Verify a mirrored drawing appears on the opposite side of the canvas

title: Export a spritesheet with metadata
description: This verifies a user can export animation frames as a spritesheet package and obtain the accompanying metadata.

steps.description: Verify a spritesheet export and its metadata are available

title: Use symmetry mode while drawing
description: This verifies a pixel artist can enable symmetry and create mirrored strokes on the canvas.

steps.description: Draw a stroke on one side of the canvas
Verify the drawing appears mirrored across the symmetry axis

title: Sample a color and continue drawing with it
description: A creator can use the eyedropper to pick an existing color and then draw with the sampled color.

steps.description: Draw with two different colors on the canvas
Sample one of the drawn colors from the canvas
Verify the sampled color is used for the new drawing

title: Export the project as JSON
description: This verifies a developer can export the current project data as a JSON file for reuse or inspection.

steps.description: Make a recognizable change to the project
Verify a project JSON export is available to download

title: Reorder layers and see the composition update
description: This verifies a user can change layer order and continue editing with the new stacking order reflected in the artwork.

steps.description: Create two layers and draw a distinct mark on each layer
Reorder the layers in the stack
Verify the composited artwork reflects the new layer order

title: Hide and lock layers to protect artwork
description: This verifies a user can hide a layer from the composition and lock a layer so it cannot be edited accidentally.

steps.description: Create a layer with visible artwork
Verify the hidden layer is not shown and the locked layer remains protected

title: Switch active colors from the palette while drawing
description: A creator can pick a different swatch from the palette and continue drawing with the new active color.

steps.description: Select one swatch in the palette
Select a different swatch in the palette
Verify the canvas contains artwork in both selected colors

title: Switch between palette colors while artwork exists
description: This verifies a user can change active colors from the palette and continue drawing on existing artwork.

steps.description: Draw a simple mark on the canvas
Draw another mark on the canvas
Verify the artwork contains marks in more than one selected color

title: Use primary and secondary colors while editing
description: A creator can set primary and secondary colors and switch between them for subsequent drawing.

steps.description: Verify the canvas shows artwork using both active colors

title: Change playback speed with FPS
description: This verifies an animator can adjust FPS and observe the animation timing change during playback.

steps.description: Create at least two frames with different drawings
Adjust the playback FPS to a different value
Verify the animation plays at the updated speed

title: Adjust layer opacity and continue editing
description: This verifies a user can make a layer partially transparent and keep working with the updated composite view.

steps.description: Create a layer with visible artwork
Adjust the layer opacity to a lower value
Verify the layer appears more transparent in the composition

title: Create a custom swatch and generate a color ramp
description: A creator can add a custom swatch and generate additional ramp colors for palette work.

steps.description: Verify additional palette steps are displayed
Verify the new swatch remains available in the palette

title: Use onion skinning while moving between frames
description: This verifies a user can enable onion skinning and see neighboring frames for alignment while editing animation.

steps.description: Create at least two frames with different drawings
Verify ghosted neighboring frames are displayed for alignment

title: Reorder frames in an animation sequence
description: This verifies a user can change frame order and see the timeline update to the new animation sequence.

steps.description: Create at least three frames with distinct drawings
Reorder the frames in the timeline
Verify the timeline reflects the new frame sequence
